title: Tabulation System
shortDesc: Fast-paced pageantry scoring with import/export of data.
longDesc:
Fast-paced pageantry scoring with import/export of data. Built with C# and Excel integration.

Used in a school pageantry event at Camarines Sur.

Features:
• Real-time scoring for judges
• Automatic calculation and ranking
• Import/export of criteria and scores via Excel
• Live leaderboard display
• Tie-breaking logic
• Print certificates and results
